findings.detail: chef-intraday cron is [13 2-8 * * 1-5] (hourly at :13) but policy chef-intraday/open resolves interval_minutes=60 for BOTH volatility tiers (no tier variance). Execution drift pushes last_fired past the nominal minute (02:13 nominal -> 02:19:14 actual), so the NEXT hourly cron tick falls only ~54 min after last_fired, fails the 60-min cadence floor, and is suppressed. 03:13 was skipped for exactly this reason. This tick fired at 04:18:40 (nominal 04:13, drift +5:40), so 05:13 will be 54.3 min later and WILL be suppressed too. Self-perpetuating: an hourly cron gated by a 60-min minimum runs every 2h forever once any drift exists. Not surfaced as a miss anywhere because the cadence gate suppresses it correctly. Fix: cadence floor must be < cron period (e.g. 45-50), or compare against nominal scheduled_utc_time instead of actual last_fired.
